summary: Hardened worktree isolation (Items 1+4 of 4, required minimum). Item 1 — per-path LEASE in lib/git.js: createWorktree(ws,key,{owner}) atomically acquires <wt>.lease (O_EXCL 'wx') before `git worktree add`; a 2nd agent racing the same path gets {contended,held} not a collision. Stale leases (dead pid + aged past ORCH_LEASE_STALE_MS=1h) reclaimable; removeWorktree frees it; re-entrant same-pid. Exports leasePath/acquireLease/releaseLease/readLease. Item 4 — dirty-GC guard in scripts/gc-worktrees.js gcWorktree: re-probes `git status --porcelain` immediately before the destructive remove, refuses (SKIPPED) on any uncommitted change/probe-fail — closes the scan→reap TOCTOU window. Items 2+3 left untouched (already satisfied: orch/attempt/<slug> = branch-per-task off base; merge_attempt→/git/merge auto-aborts on conflict for the judge); renaming to darwin/task-<id> would break every in-flight worktree + merge/GC paths. Files: lib/git.js, scripts/gc-worktrees.js, test/git.test.js (31/31), test/gc-worktrees.test.js (new, 9/9); git-merge.test.js regression-clean 15/15. HELD FOR MERGE on isolated worktree worktrees/self/worktree-isolation, branch darwin/task-worktree-isolation (1 commit ahead of main, NOT merged). Main checkout + other agent's uncommitted work untouched.
